meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 用 Astropy 进行天文与天体物理数据分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是天文学家或天体物理学家，需要处理天文数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an astronomer or astrophysicist working with astronomical data.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在你写或改 Python 天文代码时,会按 Astropy 天文库的习惯来写:比如把天体坐标在几种坐标系之间转换、换算天文单位、读写 FITS 文件、算宇宙学距离等。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 写或调试用 Astropy 做天文数据分析的 Python 代码时触发,例如坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、宇宙学计算等。

say.text: 把 ICRS 赤经赤纬转成银道坐标,用 Astropy 写 Python 代码。
say.note: Claude 会用 SkyCoord 完成坐标转换。

say.text: 读取 image.fits,打印头信息并给出图像均值和方差。
say.note: 用 astropy.io.fits 打开并分析。

say.text: 用 Planck18 模型算红移 1.5 的光度距离和宇宙年龄。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses Astropy's standard APIs to write or debug Python astronomy code: unit conversions, coordinate transforms, FITS I/O, cosmological distances, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task involves writing or debugging astronomical data analysis code using Astropy—e.g., coordinate transformations, FITS file I/O, cosmological distance calculations.

say_en.text: Convert a celestial object from ICRS to Galactic coordinates with Astropy.
say_en.note: Claude will use SkyCoord for the transform.

say_en.text: Read image.fits, print its header, give image mean and variance.
say_en.note: Claude uses astropy.io.fits to open and inspect the file.

say_en.text: Compute luminosity distance and universe age at z=1.5 with Planck18.
say_en.note: Claude uses astropy.cosmology for this computation.
